why: The Old WNS Station is the abandoned World News Service broadcasting studio on Drake and Pershing in Northside, a two-storey shell of ground-floor production rooms and an upstairs studio/office where Max Jones hides out. Vanilla keeps the building itself streaming (its env prefab carries the shell, doors, ladder, turret, cameras, mines and loot) but drops every street-story phase, so in the clean slate the studio is intact and empty. This proposal restores nothing because the one person who belongs here, Max Jones, cannot yet be expressed: his community template's entries are only read under Regina's Kabuki hub, so the station's spawner #nid_12_com gets no community_options and the checker rejects max_jones/default. The venue is left exactly as it streams, with its doors and its gig-rigged security reported below for the tour.

open_questions: Check Max Jones is at the Old WNS Station. He should be sitting in the chair in the upstairs studio (workspot #nid_12_ws_max_jones, z ~22.2), which is where the Northside district phase, sts_wat_nid_12_ow and sts_wat_nid_12_bugfixing all place max_jones/default; if the studio is empty, the catalogue gap in the owner decisions is the only reason this proposal could not put him there.

Walk in through the front double door at ground level. Vanilla never drives #nid_12_entry_door and the runtime policy only covers quest-driven doors, so confirm the door is unlocked and the ground floor (first/second/third rooms, z ~18.2) is reachable.

Check the interior door block #nid_12_dvc_door_block. The district and open-world phases close it, the street story opens and unlocks it, and it has no resolved device path, so confirm it does not seal off the entrance hall, the generator/panel rooms or Max's upstairs studio.

Check the shortcut door #nid_12_dvc_shortcut_door. Vanilla opens and unlocks it during the gig and closes and unpowers it in the open-world state; with no gig running, confirm whether it is passable and that no room is cut off behind it.

Look at the station's security. The gig arms a turret, cameras, #nid_12_sec_sys and six explosive mines around the trapped entrance door; with no street story running, confirm entering and walking the rooms does not trigger a turret or a mine.

Take the roof way in. The ladder and #nid_12_tr_solo_entrance (z ~23.2) are the gig's stealth entry; confirm the ladder still reaches the roof and upper floor, so the station has a second way in if the front door is shut.

communities.why: Lead agent: Max Jones hiding out in the Old WNS station, in his default chair. Vanilla's own sts_wat_nid_12_ow phase activates exactly max_jones/default ungated; that phase is not kept, and the catalogue could not resolve the spawner's registry, so his posture is unconfirmed.

proximity_wait.why: The only nid_12 door whose full $/ path is resolved (single_door_1_002_prefabUXXPRSI inside the always-streamed sts_wat_nid_12_devices prefab), and vanilla drives it from both sts_wat_nid_12_gameplay and the district phase, so it is an interior door of this station and not a workspot. With no people placeable yet the anchor is only a placeholder for the follow-up that adds Max, when the proximity wait must fire as the player reaches the upstairs studio.
